newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, March 11 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 8 ins at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none in roads. 1 due. Max recommended draft 29 ft. 8 ins at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Seven vessels berthed, all loading, of which 1 sbmp, 1 maize, 1 sun pellets, wheat , 1 by-products, 2 sbm. 4 Vessels in roads. 11 due at 6 terminals during this week and next. Max recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary during next week. Pasa berth draft, 28 ft. 4 ins. Fw.

Rosario - Six vessels berthed of which 1 awaiting orders, 1 loading sorghum, 1 discharging fertiliser, 3 loading maize. No vessels in roads, 10 due during this week and next. Max recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Villa Constitucion - One vessel berthed discharging iron ore, none in roads, 2 due. Elevator berths - Max draft 22 ft. Fw. Max recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - One vessel berthed discharging ore, none in roads, 6 due within the next week. Max recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel.

San Pedro - One vessel berthed loading maize, none in roads. 1 Vessel due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Emilio Mitre channel. Max drafts, high tide, vessels up to 22 metres beam, 32.06 ft. fw (high tide) vessels over 22 metres beam, 32 ft. fw (high tide). Buenos Aires - 20 Vessels in port, 26 due within next week. max recommended draft 31 ft. 6 ins. Fw. High tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Buenos Aires dock sud - Max recommended draft, 29 ft. Fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Two vessels berthed, both loading, of which 1 fish, 1 wheat. 1 vessel in roads, 5 due within the next week. Max recommended draft at entrance channel, 40 ft.Bw. Bahia Blanca - Three vessels berthed, all loading, of which 2 wheat, 1 malt. 1 Vessel in roads. 7 due within the next week. Max drafts vary for individual berths.

BRAZIL, March 11 - Vitoria - Four vessels berthed, of which 3 dischargers (1 coils, 2 bulk wheat), 1 pig iron loader. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders, 1 petroleum discharger. Praia Mole - 1 Steel products loader, 1 coal discharger. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. Ubu - 1 Iron ore loader, 24 vessels waiting in roads. Santos - 22 Vessels berthed of which 1 bulk lpg discharger, 1 full container discharger, 3 full container loaders/dischargers, 1 full container loader, 1 bulk fertiliser discharger, 1 bulk cement discharger, 1 bulk chemical products discharger, 1 sulphur discharger, 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 general cargo/juice loader/discharger, 1 salt discharger, 2 general cargo loaders, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 general cargo loader/discharger, 1 container/ro-ro loader/discharger, 2 bulk pellets loaders, 1 bulk caustic soda discharger, 1 clay discharger. 5 Vessels waiting in roads, 63 due over the next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 2 Steel products loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Paranagua - Stevedores out on strike from 12.00 hrs. 5/3, but returned to work 13.00 hrs.7/3. The strike did not spread to other ports. 11 Vessels berthed of which 1 container discharger, 5 general cargo dischargers, 2 reefer loaders, 2 pellets loaders, 1 soya loader. 21 Vessels waiting in roads, all to load, of which 14 pellets, 5 general cargo, 12 soya. 26 Vessels due over the next 7 days. Rio Grande - Six vessels berthed of which 4 full container loaders, 2 fertiliser dischargers. No vessels in roads, 12 due over the next 10 days.

Rio de Janeiro - 13 Vessels berthed of which 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 2 wheat dischargers, 2 steel products dischargers, 1 general cargo/container discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 passenger vessel, 2 general cargo loaders, 1 general cargo/steel products loaders, 1 general cargo/container loader, 1 sugar loader. Tecon - 2 Vessel. 20 Vessels due over the next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 3 Vessels berthed, no vessels at commercial quay, none in roads, 5 due over the next 7 days.

CHILE, March 10 - Arica - Three vessels berthed and operating, 2 berths vacant, 6 vessels due during the week. Iquique - Three vessels berthed and operating, 4 berths vacant, 8 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Three vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant. 7 Vessels due during the week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Seven vessels berthed and operating, no berths vacant. 1 Berth (pier 3) out of service until April for enlarging. 26 Vessels due during the week with 1 days delay expected.

San Antonio - Seven vessels operating, 1 berth vacant, 20 vessels due during the week, port busy, but no waiting time expected. Puerto Montt - One coaster, 1 passenger vessel berthed, 5 vessels due during the week. Punta Arenas - Two vessels berthed, 4 vessels due during the week. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed and operating, 4 vessels due this week, none in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels berthed and operating, 1 berth vacant, 7 vessels due during the week, 1 days berthing delay expected. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels berthed at terminal, 5 due during the week. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, 1 due this week. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel at terminal, 1 due this week. Oil terminal - No vessels, 1 due during the week. Lirquen - Three vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant, 4 vessels due during the week. Penco - One vessel at terminal.

PERU, March 10 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Three vessels anchored, 4 general cargo/container vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Paita - No vessels anchored, 1 bulk wheat vessel berthed, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels, no delays. Talara - One oil tanker anchored, no berthing delays. Chimbote - One vessel anchored, 2 fish meal vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Ilo - Two concentrates vessels anchored, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, March 10 - Puerto Cabello - Two vessels anchored. 11 Vessels berthed of which 5 grain, 3 bulk cargo, 3 containers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Due to dredging work from 09.023.00 hrs., Pier 21 area is not available. No berthing/unberthing delays expected. The entrance channel will be closed from 09.00-18.00 hrs. 12-15/3 to remove a shipwreck. Guanta - Four vessels anchored, 3 general cargo vessels berthed. March 11 - All ports working normally. Orinoco river - Draft on 11/3, 32 ft. 0 ins. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels loading iron ore, 5 vessels due. Mile 178 - Three vessels waiting at anchor to load/discharge. Matanzas - Five vessels loading steel products, 3 vessels due.

San Felix - Two vessels due. Punta Cuchillo - One vessel due. Alcasa - One vessel due. La Guaira - Three vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 6 due, 2 under repair. Puerto Cabello - 10 Vessels operating of which 9 loading/discharging general cargo, 1 discharging barley. 15 Vessels due. Guanta - Three vessels operating of which 1 loading/discharging general cargo, 1 discharging grain, 1 loading steel billets, 3 vessels due. El Tablazo - One vessel loading urea. Bajo Grande - Refined products terminal - 3 Vessels due. Amuay - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products. Cardon - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products.
